status — 24 assumed, 23 derived, 1 published. Nothing here is a design value.

Generated by tools/figures/spec_readme.py from sim/spec/*.yaml, sim/plant/spec.py and the code that loads the specs. Concept assumptions, not design values; the simulations they feed are synthetic (sim/README.md,

g.text: Terms: CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CoM = centre of mass · DQ-nnn = decision question

for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml ·

MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics engine for the level-2 walker model · SPEC-nnn = simulation parameter spec record (sim/spec/) · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record
